annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions — European approach to artificial intelligence — Artificial Intelligence Act
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions — European approach to artificial intelligence — Artificial Intelligence Act
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 97
annotation.summary_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions on the Commission's proposed AI Act. It proposes 31 amendments to recitals, articles and annexes, aiming to give local and regional authorities roles in consultation, supervision, and codes of conduct. It also seeks stronger transparency, anti-discrimination and ethics duties, and a tighter social-scoring ban.
key_provisions_or_claims: Local and regional authorities should be consulted before exceptional real-time remote biometric identification and be empowered to supervise and enforce.
Expands transparency duties to affected persons, with instructions in the local language and publication of conformity declarations.
Adds anti-discrimination measures and ethical-assessment duties for providers and users of high-risk AI.
Broadens the prohibitions on subliminal techniques and social scoring, and raises concern about its safeguards.
Raises concern about administrative burden and certification costs; calls for clarity, ex ante advice, sandboxes and public information campaigns.
